summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting proposals to sunset or eliminate it, and to work with schools to modernize the program rather than reduce its role in public education.

claims.argument: Reducing or eliminating E-Rate would have a direct and tangible impact on school budgets
claims.evidence_quote: Finding the necessary funds to support our network infrastructure would severely hamper our school district, along with many others. Those costs would ultimately compete with the resources we use to support students and educators.
